title.narrative: EU4Accountability – Empowered Civil Society for Increased Social Accountability in Moldova

description.narrative: The Action is designed to improve social accountability of the local and central government of Moldova by strengthening the capacity of local, grassroot Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) to participate in, monitor, and advocate for greater public accountability and to participate in the policy dialogue with the Local Public Authorities (LPAs) and the central government.
